name: Deno Sandbox

modes.label: Sandbox microVM (2 vCPU fixed), active CPU + allocated memory
modes.note: CPU billed on CPU time actually consumed ($0.10/CPU-h); memory billed on configured allocation (768 MB-4 GB, default 1.2 GiB) for every second the sandbox lives. Shape is fixed at 2 vCPU. Lifetime max 30 min ('session' default dies with the client; duration timeouts keep billing memory until they expire). Draws down the plan's shared Deploy meters first (Pro 50 CPU-h / 750 GiB-h; Builder 500 / 7,500). Granularity/minimum unpublished. Basis verified 2026-09-28: "You're only billed for CPU while your app is actively running code. CPU isn't consumed while your app is waiting for incoming requests or blocked on network I/O." ; "Sandbox compute bills through the same CPU, memory, and egress meters at your plan's rates" (https://deno.com/deploy/pricing). Memory billed on allocation per second loaded.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Sandboxes not included on Free (Deploy apps only; hard cut-off at limits).

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Fee is not credit but bundles meter allowances shared with Deploy apps: 50 CPU-h ($5) + 750 GiB-h memory ($18.75) = included_usd 23.75 (only valid if usage splits across both meters), plus 200 GiB egress and 5 GiB volumes. Concurrency 3 sandboxes PER REGION (ams + ord = 6 total); docs still say 5/org pre-release. 10 team members.

plans.name: Builder
plans.note: Allowances: 500 CPU-h ($50) + 7,500 GiB-h ($187.50) = 237.5, plus 2,000 GiB egress and 50 GiB volumes. 20 concurrent per region (40 across ams + ord). 25 team members.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom limits/rates, 99.95% SLA, SOC2 report + DPA, HIPAA BAA on request. Unpublished.

perf_source: No benchmark row: provider is not in ComputeSDK results or the HPC run (as of 2026-09-28). See research/perf-map.json.

knobs.label: Share of sandbox lifetime the CPU is busy
knobs.why: Deno bills CPU only while code executes (I/O wait and idle are free); memory still bills for the whole lifetime.

caveats: Hard shape: 2 vCPU fixed, 768 MB-4 GB memory, 10 GB ephemeral disk. 4 vCPU / 8 GiB workloads are infeasible.
Lifetime max 30 min per docs (extendTimeout exists but docs still state the 30-min bound); longer work must re-create sandboxes or be promoted to a Deploy app.

Plan allowances are shared with Deploy apps and are meter-specific (CPU-h, GiB-h, egress, volumes); included_usd is the $ value of CPU+memory allowances and is only exact if both meters are fully used.
Concurrency is per region (Pro 3, Builder 20); docs say 5/org during pre-release. Plan 'concurrency' is the per-region number.
Egress free allowance is plan-dependent (Free 20 / Pro 200 / Builder 2,000 GiB); card uses the Pro 200 GiB.

Snapshots are read-only images of volumes; separate snapshot billing not published — modeled at the $0.20/GiB-mo volume rate (5 GiB Pro / 50 GiB Builder free not modeled). Volumes only in ord (Chicago).

Dated change: launch prices (2026-02-03) were $0.05/CPU-h and $0.016/GB-h with Pro including 40 CPU-h + 1,000 GB-h; now $0.10 and $0.025 via shared Deploy meters. Effective date of the increase not found.
Billing granularity / minimum per sandbox unpublished. No start fee published.
SOC2/ISO27001 claimed in FAQ; SOC2 report/DPA are Enterprise-only on the pricing table. HIPAA BAA enterprise contracts only.
No benchmark data in benchmarks.json (vendor claims <200 ms start, demo 93 ms).

fleet.tiers: Current Deploy pricing: Free no sandbox access; Pro 3 concurrent per org per region; Builder 20; Enterprise custom.
fleet.notes: Sandbox overview still says prerelease default 5 and contact deploy@deno.com for an increase. Treat as a documentation conflict, not a current universal default. Current pricing governs new plans; 10 fits Builder, 50/300/1,000 need Enterprise/contact.
